body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics unveiled its new mp3 player 'TicToc(model: YP-S1)' with stylish and minimalism design during CES 2010.
The TicToc distinguishes itself with a unique one-button control that carries out different functions depending on how the player is held.
Available in two storage capacities(2GB/4GB), it is capable of 12 hours of playback time and is compatible with MP3, WMA, OGG, WAV, and FLAC audio formats.
